definitions.explanation: The act of treating someone with disrespect or scorn, damaging their dignity or honor. Has both everyday and legal usage.

examples.japanese: {侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{耐|た}えられない→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: Being humiliated in public is unbearable.

examples.japanese: {侮辱|ぶじょく}{罪|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}えられる→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a possibility of being charged with the crime of insult.

notes:
GRAMMAR: Functions as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to be insulted)
- {侮辱|ぶじょく}{罪|ざい} (crime of insult, defamation)
- {侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な (insulting, contemptuous)
- ⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{侮辱|ぶじょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to insult someone's character)

LEGAL: {侮辱|ぶじょく}{罪|ざい} is a criminal offense under Japanese law (Article 231 of the Penal Code), distinct from ⟦{名誉|めいよ}{毀損|きそん}→名誉毀損：17874_meiyokison⟧ (defamation). Online insults have come under increasing legal scrutiny.
